C0362.title: Self-Developed Decryption Program Used Over 2.18 Million Times by Others
C0362.summary: Defendant Li built a website offering a cracking program, which was used over 2.18 million times. Zhuo further wrote scripts for batch cracking and extraction, illegally obtaining over 15,000 sets of share links and their extraction passwords. Li was sentenced for providing programs used to invade computer information systems.
